## Details

<a id="sprite_frames"></a>
### [`sprite_frames`](../../../../src/graphics/sprite_frames.asm#L6) `$4800-$54BF`

*data*

Hardware sprite frames $20-$52 (51 frames of 64 bytes). Only the VIC-II reads them. A frame record ($bc51) adds $20 to its sprite numbers 0-$32. $8e7a adds $0d more when the fighter faces left. The sprite animations ($cacf, $95ed) also add $20 to each frame number.

<a id="sprite_frames_mirrored"></a>
### [`sprite_frames_mirrored`](../../../../src/graphics/sprite_frames.asm#L1096) `$54C0-$5FFF`

*data*

Hardware sprite frames $53-$7f (45 frames). The frames for fighter 1 have no copy for the other side. $8b91 mirrors all 45 frames in place when $b7 bit 7 is set (fighter 1 turns). $8c8a exchanges frames $53-$5f with the 13 frames at $fc40 only when $bb bit 7 is set. Part 1 never sets it.

- **Referred to by:** [`swap_end_shapes`](../story/end_swaps.md#swap_end_shapes)
